normalize_images: normalize an image tensor to zero mean and unit variance using the Gemma vision encoder constants
pre_process_image: pre-process an image by JPEG re-encoding, bilinear resizing, normalizing, and clipping pixel values
patchify_images: extract fixed-size patches from a batch of images using convolution-based patch extraction
load_image_files: load image files from disk, pre-process them, and extract patches for the Gemma vision encoder
review_image_preprocessing_pipeline: review the Gemma vision encoder image preprocessing pipeline including normalization, resizing, and patch extraction
